caption: The drawing depicts the upper portion of a human-like statue or figure with defined features and visible signs of damage or wear. The figure has dark, wavy hair and is looking upward with its head tilted back. The skin tone is a light brown or terracotta shade, and the figure is clothed in a loosely draped white garment that covers both shoulders and falls in naturalistic folds. Visible damage, including spots where the surface appears chipped or fractured, is present on the neck, shoulders, and arms. The right arm is slightly raised with the hand grasping a circular laurel wreath, represented with overlapping, grey-green leaves, held near the body's center. The background is plain and off-white, with a few small brownish stains or spots on the upper left side. The overall color palette is muted, primarily consisting of earthy skin tones, white, grey-green, and faint pinkish hues on the garment’s fastenings.
title: Figurehead
